title: Sahaabaa Garagalte
intro: Seenaa lubbuu gaaddidduu raajii keessa jiraattee garuu daandii gara badiisaatti geessu filatte saaxiluudhaaf jirta. Lakkoofsi kun ergamtoota Rabbiin filataman keessaa tokko waliin mana tokko waliin qooddatu garuu qormaata iimaana hin milkoofne. Hiriyaan bade kun eenyu?
clues: Namoota waamicha qajeelummaa didan gidduu jiraadheera, isaanis hin mormine.
Nabiyyii Rabbii tokkotti heerumeen ture, garuu amantaa sana hin qoodne.
Ergamtoonni akeekkachiisa qabatanii gara mana koo yommuu dhufan ani isaan hin amanne.
Haati manaa koo amantoota waliin magaalattii akka baatu ajajame, ani immoo isaan keessaa hin turre.
Adabbiin saba koo irratti bu’ee, anis isaan waliin balleeffame.
Qur’aana keessatti akka fakkeenya kufriitti, haadha manaa Nuh cinatti, suuraa At-Tahrim keessatti ibsameera.

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
